title: snapshot
description: The snapshot: every product, where each part of it stands, and what waits for the owner, as the Focus and Products pages and `status -o json` show it. It is made from the parts control-room's connectors read and keep in memory, so a reader sees what the pages see.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/control-room/app/v1: the form of control-room's answers (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml).

kind.description: Always Snapshot, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

source.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always control-room, its product ID, since only control-room gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Every product and what waits for the owner.
